# Hi there, I'm Dima 👋

### DevSecOps Engineer | Infrastructure & Security Automation

I'm a DevSecOps engineer from **Ukraine** 🇺🇦. I run Kubernetes clusters and Terraform pipelines, and build the security checks around them.

- Scaling Kubernetes clusters and automating security checks in CI/CD
- Writing about what breaks and how we fixed it at [dmytrobot.dev/blog](https://dmytrobot.dev/blog/)
